verdict.rationale: Mistral ships a dedicated developer quickstart titled "Send your first API request", plus official Python and TypeScript SDKs with a one-line install (`pip install mistralai`). That covers the core path from zero to a first call. Coverage beyond Python and TypeScript relies on third-party, non-official SDKs, and the evidence shows only the quickstart's title, not its contents. Missing for 10: evidence of the quickstart's runnable code samples and time-to-first-call, official SDKs or snippets for languages beyond Python/TypeScript, independent hands-on corroboration of the onboarding flow.
